findings.summary: The sweep found idle storage and IP resources across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, plus several stale Google snapshots. Most findings are low-dollar items, with the largest recurring costs coming from unassociated public IPs and the gp3 EBS volume. The AWS stale snapshots query returned no results.
